concept.title: What Is Autofill
concept.shortdesc: Autofill allows users to fill in information quickly for online forms and documents.

conbody.p: Autofill is a feature in many browsers, operating systems, and other programs that allows users to quickly complete online forms or documents. Autofill stores your data like name, address, contact details, payment methods, and more. With this feature enabled, you don’t need to manually enter the same information over and over again.

Autofill works by extracting data from the browser or system cookie. When it finds a match for the field on a particular page, it will automatically fill in all the required information for you. The browser stores your data securely so that only you have access to it. You can also specify which sites should have access to your stored data and which sites shouldn’t have access.
